plugins.name: bidskim
plugins.description: UK public procurement intelligence: search live UK government tenders from Find a Tender, Contracts Finder, Public Contracts Scotland and Sell2Wales; track contract renewals with incumbent suppliers and expiry dates; and research public-sector buyers and suppliers. Adds three workflow skills for building a renewal pipeline, scanning tenders that fit what you sell, and briefing a buyer before you bid. Connects to BidSkim's hosted MCP server (OAuth sign-in; BidSkim Predict plan required).

skills.name: buyer-brief
skills.description: Research a UK public-sector buyer before bidding - their awards, spend patterns, top suppliers, and upcoming renewals. Use when the user names a council, NHS trust, or other public body and wants to understand it, or asks "what has X bought/awarded".
skills.description_zh: 在投标前调查英国公共部门采购方的授标、支出模式、主要供应商与即将续约的合同，适用于议会、NHS 信托等公共机构。

skills.name: renewal-radar
skills.description: Find UK public-sector contracts in the user's market that expire soon, who holds them, and which ones to engage now. Use when the user asks about expiring contracts, contract renewals, incumbents, or wants pipeline beyond published tenders.
skills.description_zh: 查找用户所在市场即将到期的英国公共部门合同、现任供应商及应及时接触的机会，帮助发现已发布招标之外的销售管线。

skills.name: tender-scan
skills.description: Search live UK tenders that fit what the user's business actually does and rank them by fit and deadline. Use when the user wants current tender opportunities, open procurements, or a scan of what's closing soon in their market.
skills.description_zh: 搜索当前开放且符合用户实际业务的英国招标机会，并按匹配程度和截止日期排序。
